# Public Ads India

> Public Ads India is India's #1 Zero Investment Company and premier fintech CPA affiliate ad network, headquartered in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh. The platform enables publishers, students, homemakers, and agencies to earn guaranteed daily income through verified Demat account opening work, telecalling BPO projects, and financial app referrals with 100% free registration and instant daily UPI payouts.

## Key Facts & Entity Information

- **Company Name**: Public Ads India (PAI)
- **Industry**: Fintech, CPA Affiliate Marketing, Performance Advertising, Remote Work
- **Headquarters**: Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India (Coordinates: 26.4499° N, 80.3319° E)
- **Official Website**: https://www.publicadsindia.com/
- **Pricing & Joining Fee**: ₹0 (100% Free / Zero Investment Work / No Security Deposit)
- **Supported Payout Methods**: Instant Daily UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), IMPS / Direct Bank Transfer
- **Rating**: 4.9 / 5 Stars (1,850+ Verified Reviews)
- **Active Publishers**: 15,000+ registered partners across PAN India
- **Support Contact**: +91 8934932418 | publicadsnetwork@gmail.com

## Core Zero Investment Work Programs

### 1. Demat Account Opening Work
- **Overview**: Help clients and investors open free Demat and trading accounts with India's top stockbrokers.
- **Supported Brokers**: Angel One, Kotak Neo, Choice Broking, Jainam Broking, Upstox, Paytm Money.
- **Payout Rate**: ₹250 to ₹700 per successful account activation and verified trade.
- **Requirements**: Smartphone or Computer, active internet connection, basic customer assistance.

### 2. Telecalling & BPO Projects
- **Overview**: Remote telecalling and customer support projects assisting users in completing KYC documentation.
- **Working Hours**: Flexible part-time (2–3 hours/day) or full-time schedules.
- **Payouts**: Weekly and daily performance incentives credited directly to bank/UPI.

### 3. Fintech CPA Affiliate Offers
- **Overview**: Promote high-converting banking products, savings accounts, and financial utility apps.
- **Tracking**: Real-time automated MIS dashboard tracking lead submission, KYC status, and settlement status.

## Daily Settlement & Payout Policy

- **No Threshold Delay**: Earnings are disbursed daily upon lead verification without waiting for monthly billing cycles.
- **Zero Commission Deduction**: 100% of the listed payout amount is transferred with zero hidden maintenance deductions.
- **Proof-Backed Verification**: Publishers upload screenshot proofs of account creation for transparent audit trails.
